scope: Local Playwright screenshots from the existing Vite app with an in-memory read-only fixture. A candidate baseline is not an owner-approved canonical golden.

runtime.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/153.0.8010.12 Safari/537.36

policy.settle: networkidle, required root visible, fonts ready, reduced-motion, animation/transition suppression, 750ms after injection; 150ms between duplicate captures

pairPixel.purpose: duplicate-capture reproducibility only; not cross-revision visual acceptance

invariants: document scrollWidth equals viewport width where no overflow is expected

policy.candidateSelection: first capture (-a) is the candidate image; second capture (-b) is a same-state reproducibility receipt
policy.canonicalRule: Do not promote without a pinned owner-approved route/state fixture, source revision, browser build, theme/locale, viewport/deviceScaleFactor and independent review.
